rules.notes: Leader max 1 + Support max 1 per unit; 1 enhancement per attached unit; Crusader Squad minimum 4 Neophytes.

units.name: Captain
units.notes: Plain/power-armour Captain. Prior owned.json listed 'Captain (power armour)' under not_owned; authoritative override wins.

units.notes: Resolves prior FLAG in owned.json (Sep 30 table vs Oct 14 'no Captain' wording).

units.name: Techmarine
units.notes: Owned; often left out of lists by preference (solo), not an ownership gap.

units.name: Assault Intercessor Squad
units.notes: 10 Assault Intercessors = 2 boxes of 5. Resolves Assault_Intercessors_second_box FLAG.

units.name: Crusader Squad
units.notes: Two 20-man kits. Each: 1 Sword Brother + 11 Initiates (7 chainsword + 4 power fist) + 8 Neophytes. Validator: min 4 Neophytes per Crusader Squad (owned kits have 8). Kit Sword Brothers are separate from the 8 standalone Sword Brethren.

units.name: Sword Brethren Squad
units.notes: 8 Sword Brethren models separate from the 2 Sword Brothers inside the Crusader Squads (10 SB models total pool). Older owned.json said 'SB box 5'; authoritative 8 wins. Can be fielded as one 4–8 or split within datasheet limits.

units.name: Terminator Assault Squad
units.loadout: thunder hammer + storm shield (default); one model may be lightning claws
units.notes: 5 Assault Terminators. Default TH+SS; one may be lightning claws — treat LC option as loadout-flexible (WYSIWYG). Resolves prior TAS FLAG.

units.name: Scout Squad
units.notes: Separately owned 5 Scouts (not Neophyte proxies). Resolves Scouts_5 FLAG in owned.json.

units.name: Vanguard Veteran Squad with Jump Packs
units.notes: Auth list did not state model count; v981 list export and owned tray consistently use 5 (1 sergeant + 4).
